## November 11, 2026 — Sweep clearance in confined spaces (author approved)

**Minimum maneuvering room.** A Sweep requires enough clear room for two people to stand shoulder to shoulder. A Wide Sweep requires enough for three. These are minimums for making the attack, even against one target. The actual weapon motion and its path must also be clear.

**Weapon coverage.** A slashing attack uses its listed coverage. A player cannot downgrade a Sweep or Wide Sweep to a single-target slash to fit a confined space. A light slashing cleaver with a compact motion can work in cramped quarters. Light handling alone does not waive the clearance requirement of an attack listed as Sweep. A weapon can use a genuine alternate attack if its own motion fits. A greatsword whose Wide Sweep is blocked can use its single-target Point thrust if there is room to thrust.

**Terrain.** Judge clearance after accounting for physical barriers such as an ice wall. A barrier can deny room to sweep without directly targeting a combatant. A pike's Line uses its approved straight-path and reach rules. In a tight corridor it can hit two aligned targets when both are reachable. The benchmark uses three greatsword hits in open ground, one greatsword thrust in a tight corridor, and two pike hits in the corridor as scenario assumptions. Individual hits use normal Power. The squad rule above now governs Line.

Recorded in Combat, Equipment and Economy, the melee catalogue, and the Canon Index. Existing forward arcs, target caps, and Line individual-target resolution still apply.

## November 10, 2026 — Celestite Leydrain tiers, additive overlaps, voluntary-combat Soul Shred and no zero-MP extra punishment (LATEST AUTHOR APPROVAL)

**LATEST SPECIFIC APPROVAL OVERRIDES EARLIER CELESTITE LEYDRAIN <5 AT ALL ARMOR CLASSES:** Celestite armor's innate Leydrain **radius and strict spell-channel cancellation threshold** scale by protection class: **Light: radius 5m, nullifies channeled spells costing strictly LESS THAN 5 MP; Medium: 10m, suppresses spells costing strictly LESS THAN 10 MP; Heavy: 15m, suppresses spells costing strictly LESS THAN 15 MP.** A spell whose relevant MP cost equals the threshold is NOT canceled by that field's under-threshold rule alone. Friendly/beneficial/self-originated spells remain subject to cancellation. The existing separate automatic **wearer MP drain of 5/10/15 MP per turn** for Light/Medium/Heavy is UNCHANGED. This change is to the spell-canceling numeric threshold, not the radius or armor MP debit.

**AUTHOR APPROVES LEYDRAIN STACKING:** Multiple simultaneously active Celestite Leydrain effects, including armor+weapon or other valid Celestite items, do **not** merely pick the strongest; they combine to make heavily equipped Celestite users especially difficult to affect magically. **Provisional operational interpretation for straightforward field interaction (pending explicit author confirmation if necessary):** At a location inside multiple field radii, **add all those fields' applicable spell-suppression MP thresholds**, giving an effective strictly-below combined cutoff. E.g. within the intersection of two Heavy-armor-equivalent 15-MP fields, channeling of a spell costing LESS THAN 30 MP vanishes; outside the intersection but in only one 15-MP field, the single 15 cutoff applies. Radii represent distinct areas and do NOT automatically add their linear distances. The weapon's own numerical Leydrain threshold/radius, if not yet specified by its subject canon, remain OPEN and cannot be fabricated. This additive-threshold scheme is an implementation proposal consistent with the author's explicit stacking directive, rather than an invented previously approved weapon value.

**AUTHOR APPROVES 'SOUL SHRED' NAME AND VOLUNTARY COMBAT CONDITION:** The armor's fixed-reference accumulated-XP erosion is officially named **Soul Shred**. Celestite armor does NOT shred XP merely while worn, during travel, in passive proximity to monsters, or solely because hostile creatures initiate combat/attack the wearer. It activates in **actual combat WHEN THE WEARER CHOOSES TO FIGHT BACK / WILLINGLY ENGAGE in the conflict**, taking deliberate combat participation rather than passively being attacked as the trigger. Thereafter while actively committed to the combat engagement, **each qualifying turn** destroys **5% of the wearer's TOTAL XP snapshot taken when they first donned the armor**, with the original fixed baseline, possibly causing level regression and associated loss. Do not charge one Soul Shred turn for every ambient enemy projectile or automatically from initiative. An ineffective kobold harassing a nonretaliating Celestite traveler does not activate Soul Shred. Do not interpret the rule as allowing attack one turn then negate the cost every other turn simply by holding a defensive posture within the same continuing voluntary fight; detailed engagement-end/disengagement boundaries can be settled in combat rules. Nonviolent travel, clear nonengagement and actual withdrawal do not by themselves trigger Soul Shred. The weapon's distinct already approved XP/soul loss per stroke still stacks when wielded/used; no free exemption for actively wielding both.

**NO EXTRA FATE AT ZERO MANA (APPROVED):** Celestite armor MP drain reduces currently available MP no lower than **0 MP**. If MP reaches zero or is insufficient to cover the full listed debit, the wearer simply has zero MP, with no separate soul injury, instant incapacitation, wound, XP penalty, spell explosion or forced end of armor functionality merely because the MP debit could not be fully paid. Soul Shred and anti-magic field retain their otherwise legitimate triggers/effects; normal ordinary consequences of being unable to pay MP for one's own spells remain. The armor's special exemption from stat-shortfall due to its own induced level-down remains intact.

**UNRESOLVED EDGE CASES:** Detailed exact combat commitment trigger for purely defensive fighting, duration of an engagement or disengagement, once-per-turn scheduling and rounding, persistent original XP snapshot per wearer through removal/re-donning, how canceled spells are treated when channeled outside and entering fields, specific Celestite weapon Leydrain numeric parameters and total item stacking, and precise QV AR/MR/STR/DEX/SPD profiles (prior Quill suggested but not approved Heavy AR180/MR185/STR65). Do not invent Celestite weapon item data or distort existing godslayer per-stroke soul erosion. No XP drain should occur just from an imposed encounter with no voluntary retaliation/engagement.


## November 10, 2026 — Thornspring turn-long offensive/evasive Springload; Celestite Quality V armor approved (LATEST AUTHOR DECISION)

### Thornspring burst timing correction (APPROVED)

**SUPERSEDES one-maneuver-only duration:** When a Thornspring wearer deliberately **expends one Springload charge**, the class-specific **situational SPD bonus lasts for the ENTIRE CURRENT TURN**, not one movement, dash or dodge. This applies to applicable **offensive and evasive SPD-based combat comparisons**, including sudden charges/closing on an opponent and running away from incoming attacks where normal rules permit. Quality V working class bonuses are **Light +50%, Medium +75%, Heavy +35%** to effective situational SPD for that turn, not passive permanent SPD or an extra action. It is not itself a generic multiplicative bonus to weapon Power, an additional attack, a free hit, or an override of Trapped/otherwise illegal dodges. Existing wound, injury, equipment-shortfall, cover, pressure, reaction, action/initiative rules remain unless a separately approved rule says otherwise. The mechanism's exact applicability to attacks beyond positional/relative-speed comparison and turn-end timing remain integration details, not permission to change universal attack Power. Springload capacity one, permanent charge storage (including charges gained in combat), full-turn manual winding by wearer/ally, and genuine-hit recharge remain approved.

### Celestite divine armor (APPROVED)

**EXCEPTIONAL EXISTENCE AND AVAILABILITY:** Celestite can be forged as **Light, Medium and Heavy armor**, but **ONLY at Smithcraft/workmanship Quality V**, with NO Quality I, II, III or IV item versions or corresponding material stats. As with Celestite weapons, actual production still requires the original exceptional **triune divine forging with Arrest, Surrender and Baphomet** and extraordinary Centaur craftsmanship, not merely an ordinary Quality V smith or market purchase. This is an approved extraordinary exception to normal material tiers. Preserve the existing Celestite anti-ley-line, soul-destroying God War lore and unconditional Drakyn treasure-detection consequences.

**PHYSICAL/MAGICAL PROTECTION AND REQUIREMENTS:** At matching protective armor class, coverage and Quality V, Celestite's baseline **Armor Resistance (AR) is slightly HIGHER than Adamantite**, and its baseline **Magic Resistance (MR) slightly HIGHER than Nullporcelain**, not astronomically beyond either. Its required **STR lies between Boughsteel's and Adamantite's corresponding Quality V armor support STR**. Actual Quality V Full Heavy comparison anchors: Adamantite AR170 (working approved), Nullporcelain MR170 (working approved), Boughsteel STR36 and Adamantite STR91 (working test/support benchmarks). Exact Celestite AR/MR/STR values and appropriate other-class comparative Adamantite AR/Boughsteel/Adamantite STR and mobilities are OPEN, not numerical canon. No automatic celestial extra armor penetration, regeneration, immunity or universal MR-to-AR equation is invented.

**PASSIVE MP DRAIN, EVERY TURN WHILE WORN:** Celestite Light armor drains the wearer **5 MP per turn**; Medium **10 MP per turn**; Heavy **15 MP per turn**. This is intrinsic anti-magic/soul effect, not optional equipment enchantment expenditure. Do not mislabel it as current equipment Soul Strain. Timing of debit and behavior when the wearer has fewer MP than required remain open.

**LEYDRAIN (APPROVED):** Celestite's passive anti-spell field has radius **5 meters Light**, **10 meters Medium**, **15 meters Heavy** from the wearer. **Any spell being channeled using LESS THAN 5 MP within that field vanishes**, including wearer-authored, friendly, healing and other positive spells, not merely hostile spells. A spell channeled with exactly 5 MP does not meet this specific below-five threshold (but is not thereby automatically immune to other Celestite defenses or effects); no new blanket cancellation of high-MP spells from this numeric rule alone. Distinguish channeled spells from unrelated nonspell environmental effects until canon defines their interactions. Whether the mana count refers to single activation cost versus total channel expenditure, overlap resolution when multiple Celestite items are present, and spell created outside the radius entering the field are implementation questions, not authorization to change the approved threshold/radii.

**SOUL/EXPERIENCE DESTRUCTION WHILE IN BATTLE (APPROVED):** On the FIRST DONNING of a Celestite armor ensemble, snapshot **the wearer's TOTAL accumulated XP** as the armor's fixed erosion reference amount (do not recompute 5% from declining current XP each turn). During battle, **each turn the wearer loses 5% OF THAT RECORDED TOTAL XP**, potentially losing levels and associated normal level-derived stats/skills, matching existing Celestite direct soul-erosion lore rather than refundable Soul Strain. XP loss is a fixed baseline percentage per turn, not 5% of *remaining* XP. The author's rule specifically states **in battle**; behavior on repeated doffing/redonning, survival at XP zero, rounding fractional XP, end-of-turn ordering, and soul destruction's terminal state need careful integration. No XP recovery or moral-protection exemption is granted by armor. Wearing Celestite after leveling down **does not incur any equipment-stat-shortfall penalty caused solely by reduced STR/DEX from this Celestite XP erosion**; after it is properly put on, the armor remains operable even if the bearer can no longer satisfy the original stat requirements. This exception does not grant general stat bonuses, eligibility to newly don armor without qualifications, immunity to wounds, or exemption from unrelated equipment shortfalls. Treat other new equipment or unrelated requirements under existing rules.

**STACKING WITH CELESTITE WEAPON (APPROVED):** If the wearer simultaneously wields a Celestite weapon, the weapon's existing **MP drain (if any applicable from the weapon's own canon), XP/soul drain per stroke, and anti-ley-line/Leydrain capability** apply **IN ADDITION** to armor's passive MP drain, battle-per-turn XP erosion and Leydrain. They do not cancel or merge for a discount. This is an additive danger and stacking design directive; exact numerical weapon MP drain and field threshold/radius stack resolution have **NOT** been separately provided in the existing weapon subject canon and must NOT be invented. Existing approved weapon soul-erosion per stroke and False Apotheosis/conviction peril are retained. Any two anti-magic field overlap effects should be respected rather than silently selecting only the better source; exact additive distance/threshold formula is not approved.

**HISTORICAL CELESTITE PRICE REFERENCE (SUPERSEDED NOVEMBER 12, 2026):** For a comparable armor class, coverage and Quality V item, Celestite armor's **LISTED DISPLAY PRICE is 5× the nominal Adamantite armor price**, marked with an asterisk **'*'** immediately clarifying that **Celestite CANNOT BE BOUGHT** and its exceptional Centaur + triune divine crafting requirements MUST be satisfied before such an artifact can be forged. This is a comparative reference valuation only, not an actual Gem market sale, conventional crafting recipe, stock availability or evidence of ordinary buyback economics. No numeric Adamantite armor Gem price is fabricated by this ruling.

**OPEN FOLLOW-UP:** finalize Quality V armor AR/MR/STR/DEX/SPD benchmarks, exact MP debit and depleted-pool result, first-donning XP-snapshot persistence if item is transferred, XP rounding/floor and death/soul-zero effects, details of how overlapping weapon+armor Leydrain radii/MP cutoff behave, whether MP limits affect active channeling across the field boundary, and whether an experience-loss event also impacts non-level XP accounting. No redefinition of the other eleven pure materials or author-approved Celestite weapon effects.


## November 10, 2026 — Thornspring numerical burst benchmarks approved; stable permanent charges and construct engineering role (LATEST AUTHOR APPROVAL)

**EXPLICIT AUTHOR ACCEPTANCE:** Author approves Quill's immediately preceding Thornspring recommendations INCLUDING the previously proposed **one Springload charge capacity per ordinary suit**, class-specific one-maneuver **Light +50%, Medium +75%, Heavy +35% situational effective SPD bursts**, and the provisional **Quality V Full-coverage armor profiles Light AR25/STR8/DEX16/MR0, Medium AR55/STR12/DEX26/MR0, Heavy AR90/STR15/DEX36/MR0** as **approved working numerical calibration**. Armor is intentionally below corresponding Boughsteel physical protection, with low STR and unusually high DEX requirements; no passive speed increase, generic extra action/dodge, bypass of Trapped or use of SPD for unrelated attack Power. The burst applies only to the qualifying dodge/evasive movement maneuver and expends its one charge; preserves existing action economy and quality-reduced gear requirements under global rules. The working suggested **physical-hit recharge criterion about 70% of a Quality-matched generalist's Solid-wound Power threshold** is accepted as a provisional balancing target, NOT a newly resolved universal combat threshold or spell damage formula. Incoming genuine physical contact can replenish this charge if qualifying, even when armor prevented injury; the gained charge does not retroactively improve the generating attack's own defense. Exact reference-generalist builds and per-quality thresholds remain pending.

**AUTHOR'S IMPORTANT EXPLICIT CAVEAT:** Charges acquired from *incoming attacks in combat* **DO NOT DISAPPEAR** afterward. Thornspring is stable and efficient; **ALL Springload charges, whether acquired from winding or physical impacts and whether acquired in combat or beforehand, remain stored indefinitely until deliberately released/spent**, within the suit's one-charge normal capacity. No expiration at end of turn, at encounter boundary, due to injury, or after ordinary calm movement. Do not reintroduce earlier ephemeral-charge suggestion. A wearer or ally can spend one full turn operating built-in winding gear to refill it to full, including before an engagement, and need not suffer attacks to start ready. Repeated meaningful impacts can replenish charge **after it has been used**; additional impacts while fully charged do not grant extra charges or stacking speed multipliers. Injury is not a separate automatic recharge trigger; genuine force transferred through the armor is the mechanism, and being wounded under intense pressure is one dramatic way this can happen.

**CONSTRUCT ENGINEERING WORLD LORE APPROVED:** Thornspring's reliable, unusually efficient elastic mechanical energy storage/recoil management is a **major foundational material/engineering backbone of Mystarian constructs and clockwork mechanisms**. Appropriate construct designs may use Thornspring in recoil assemblies, springs, joints, energy return, locomotion, shock recovery or actuators, subject to their individual build's material/craft limits. This is substantive lore supporting the broader clockwork industry; it does **NOT** mean all constructs must be made of it, every construct gains Thornspring armor's +SPD or charge mechanic, every unit receives a free stat increase, or the material creates energy without input. Existing clockwork craft, Leywell, Cogsong and stat rules remain unchanged absent separate approval.

**STILL OPEN:** Quality I–IV Thornspring AR, STR/DEX and movement effects, exact percent/damage benchmark implementation after building reference generalists, class-specific burst movement reach/route, integration with reaction/initiative and any construct-specific designs/stat bonuses. The one-charge/three-class Quality V profiles are current working canon, subject to future balance corrections. Glassweave has already received its pure-material concept and breakage treatment; among the named twelve materials Celestite is the outstanding extraordinary/divine exception to ordinary material armor calibration. Advanced composites remain separate follow-up from pure-material identities and must not silently erase past design decisions.


## November 10, 2026 — Thornspring stored readiness, manual winding and impact recharge (LATEST AUTHOR APPROVAL)

**APPROVED THORNSPRING SPRINGLOAD POLICY:** Thornspring armor has a physical **winding gear**. **Either the wearer or a willing ally can spend one full turn activating/operating it to restore its currently available Springload charge capacity to FULL** (i.e., fill charge slots, not increase their maximum count). A suitably prepared suit can enter combat fully wound; no repeated jumps, staged falls, ally attacks, fake-threat gymnastics, or other contrived antics are required. Stored Springload **does NOT expire at turn end or after a fixed number of turns**; it **remains until deliberately spent/released**. Preserving opening-turn readiness is an explicit author design objective. An ally investing their turn in a combat rewind is a meaningful tactical choice, subject to ordinary access/position/action constraints. There is no automatic free extra attack, dodge, or turn from winding.

**APPROVED SECONDARY RECHARGE ROUTE:** In combat, **actually being struck by a meaningful physical impact** can restore Springload without operating the winding gear. Reuse the **quality-matched reference-generalist wounding benchmark / relative impact threshold philosophy discussed for Hearthiron's fire recharge**, translated into appropriate physical-impact Power; do NOT require the wearer to take an actual wound to benefit, and do NOT reuse Bellcopper's distinct actual-post-defense-wound charging trigger. The impact must genuinely contact and load the springs; trivial harmless taps, staged motions, attack attempts that fully miss, psychic effects and energy-only attacks without physical impact do not qualify. The recharge cannot retroactively alter defense against the strike which generated it. No extra charging from routine noncombat motion.

**AUTHOR-APPROVED THORNSPRING SPECIALTY DIRECTION FROM CURRENT CONVERSATION:** This material should grant **brief powerful SPD bursts rather than passive SPD bonuses**, optimizing dodges/evasive positional defense; especially **Medium** should gain a large situational SPD boost on releasing Springload. Its normal physical AR is **lower than Boughsteel but not negligible**; **intrinsic MR0**. It has **low STR support requirement near conventional Boughsteel DEX handling requirement** and unusually high DEX handling requirement near Boughsteel's STR requirement at corresponding class/quality, since controlled elastic acceleration is skill-intensive. Existing global armor/gear shortfall rules apply. Do NOT invent a generic static passive SPD increase or free automatic dodge, nor allow burst to bypass actual Trapped/no-dodge conditions, create attacks, change initiative retroactively or affect unrelated weapon Power.

**NOT YET APPROVED NUMERIC PARAMETERS:** Earlier Quill proposed full-coverage Quality V Thornspring **Light AR25/STR8/DEX16, Medium AR55/STR12/DEX26, Heavy AR90/STR15/DEX36; intrinsic MR0 for all**, and Springload **one-charge** burst SPD bonuses of **Light +50%, Medium +75%, Heavy +35%**. These specific AR/STR/DEX and +SPD percentages are **unapproved placeholders**, not numeric canon. The proposed **70% of quality-matched reference generalist's Solid-wound Power threshold** as physical impact recharge is also still an **unapproved quantitative suggestion**; the benchmark should not be applied using a spell/elemental MR formula as if it were finalized physical Power. Exact charge-capacity by class, gain-per-hit, overcharging behavior, effects of shield-only hits, whether emergency ally winding needs a specific position, and timing of actual dodge spending are pending. Preserve earlier canon Thornspring extraordinary elasticity and recoil management.


## November 9, 2026 — Hearthiron low-output warmth preserves combat charges (LATEST EXPLICIT AUTHOR APPROVAL)

**AUTHOR APPROVES QUILL'S MOST RECENT RECOMMENDATION:** Hearthiron armor, including **Medium and Heavy**, can provide sustained **ordinary low-output radiant warmth without consuming a discrete Furnace Burst combat charge** while the armor has usable background retained heat. This is an intentionally negligible long-duration draw relative to a battle-scale offensive thermal discharge, NOT an exemption from finite heat storage forever and NOT permission to provide unlimited large-area extreme heating. **Medium Furnace Burst remains one charge; Heavy remains two**, each at equal Quality-based damage. Offensive burst costs a charge, high-output active effects meaningfully spend heat, extreme heat/pyromancy can replenish in combat, campfire replenishment is slower and unspecified, and high-output thermal leakage remains dangerous. Light remains the personal warmth/survival specialist. Exact AoE radius, elemental attack Power and Quality damage benchmarks, 70%-of-generalist threshold recharge test, action cost, and full resource conversion are **not newly canonized by this approval**; the previous assistant explicitly called them proposals and the author has not selected their final values. ## November 8, 2026 — Hearthiron thermal exhaustion and hazardous heat discharge APPROVED; ordinary ice weakness superseded (LATEST AUTHOR REVISION)

**LATEST AUTHOR DIRECTION REPLACES THE PREVIOUS ELEMENTAL-DRAWBACK PROPOSAL:** Preserve Hearthiron's approved **×3 Fire resistance**, high thermal inertia, substantial Bellcopper-like weight and Reprise Bronze-like physical AR. **Retire the blanket ×1.5 ICE VULNERABILITY** from the previous Hearthiron proposal; it is **SUPERSEDED** by the author's preference for heat-resource exhaustion and hazardous heat release as meaningful drawbacks. This does **not** create any new numeric ice resistance or immunity; ordinary ice-magic damage still uses applicable rules and temperature-change resistance is a separate material property. The old ice multiplier appears in historical sections below solely for archival context.

**APPROVED HEAT AS FINITE RESOURCE:** Hearthiron stores heat and consumes that store primarily when the wearer deliberately uses its most active thermal abilities (notably Heavy's offensive furnace/contact heat and extended strong radiation, with intensity governing expenditure). At low passive warmth output, its exceptionally high storage retains heat over long periods; it does NOT lose combat-scale charges merely by existing. **Thermal exhaustion** reduces/disables heat-powered active abilities until replenished, without removing basic physical AR or inherently changing its approved baseline elemental Fire resistance. High-output heat use is a tactical choice with an actual opportunity cost, not unlimited free continuous fire damage.

**APPROVED HAZARDOUS LEAKAGE:** The wearer can regulate warmth and use proper insulation, but deliberate high-heat output can endanger nearby friends, carried gear, flammable environments, and creatures in direct contact. Use existing relevant fire/elemental injury, status, reach and action rules once fully specified; no automatically free attack or guaranteed burning through defenses. Consequences of exposing others to the heat are part of the material's downside.

**APPROVED DYNAMIC REHEATING, REJECTS SLOW-FORCED-RECHARGE DRAWBACK:** Extremely powerful external heat or suitably potent pyromancy can rapidly replenish Hearthiron **even during battle**, and opponents' sufficiently powerful fire effects may be exploited to refill it. **Ordinary campfires do not instantly restore useful combat reserves**; they replenish slowly over a deliberately **unspecified longer period**, with no arbitrary numeric hours or recharge turns canonized. Refilling depends on external intensity/actual available heat, not free magical MP generation from armor. Incoming fire remains a threat/effect according to the normal resistance framework; fuel recovery is not automatic universal immunity or unlimited stored capacity. The author rejected 'slow temperature adjustment' as a universal gameplay drawback, while high thermal inertia remains an inherent material property and intense heat explicitly overcomes practical recharge delays.

**UNRESOLVED (DO NOT INVENT NUMBERS):** heat reservoir capacity and units, active-ability costs, heat gain per spell/attack/ambient source, exactly when active fire damage applies, range, how fast extreme heat recharges, ordinary campfire time, interaction of generated heat with spell mana, whether capacity changes with quality/class, AR I–IV, MR, STR/SPD and fire/ice formula implementation. Resume pure-material design with **Thornspring** once the author is satisfied; no change to other materials.

## November 8, 2026 — Bellcopper reservoir charges ONLY on actual wounds after enhanced Defense (LATEST AUTHOR CORRECTION)

**HIGHEST-PRECEDENCE AUTHOR DECISION SUPERSEDES PRIOR TRIGGER PROPOSAL:** For Heavy Bellcopper (×2.00 final physical Defense Power when empty) and Medium Bellcopper (×1.50 when empty), resolve the relevant **armor-contacting physical attack WITH Bellcopper's enhanced final Defense Power** and all ordinary applicable combat rules. The reservoir begins charging / ceases to be Ready **ONLY IF the attack STILL actually wounds the wearer** (normally Solid-or-worse physical injury after applying the bonus). An intercepted attack that resolves **Superficial and inflicts no wound** DOES NOT charge it, even if that attack would have been Solid-or-worse against unboosted ordinary Defense Power. This explicitly REJECTS the earlier Quill proposal to use *would wound against normal Defense* as its activation criterion. It preserves the reward for successfully neutralizing blows rather than taxing every dangerous-looking hit.

**THREE-TURN RESET RULE:** Once an actual post-defense wound triggers reservoir charging, apply normal, unboosted physical Defense Power to later attacks until the reservoir has drained through three uninterrupted qualifying quiet turns. Meaningful additional armor-contacting impacts can prolong/reset its settling as previously directed, but do not reinterpret a successfully harmless *first* intercepted blow as stored energy. Exact later-hit 'meaningful' eligibility and turn-count bookkeeping can be specified when needed without contradicting the wound-only initial trigger. Keep armor AR equal to Boughsteel, Bellcopper considerably heavier, Light stealth hush/grapple vocal silence and Medium partial hush. The kinetic sound release's quantitative offensive effects, and specific STR/SPD values, remain OPEN. Example with END139 and AR115: normal Defense 32,546; ready Heavy 65,092; attack Power approx. 34,971 resolves superficial at 65,092, therefore **reservoir remains empty/ready**, not Ringing.

**NEXT PURE MATERIAL FOR DESIGN: HEARTHIRON.** Canon Hearthiron can retain red heat and emit light for years under low draw, cools faster under heavier heat demand and needs insulation to avoid burning people or surroundings. It is a heat battery, not infinite energy. Proposed armor direction is a temperature-management utility suit with user-selectable insulation or radiant warmth, without inventing specific fire damage/status/AR/MR/energy rates before the author's approval.


## November 8, 2026 — Bellcopper Boughsteel-equivalent AR, greater mass, final Defense Power resonance (LATEST AUTHOR DECISION)

**LATEST APPROVAL:** At identical Quality, protective Light/Medium/Heavy class and actual coverage, pure Bellcopper has **the same physical AR as Boughsteel**, rather than a higher normal passive AR. Thus the established working Quality I–V **Full Heavy AR ladder is 75/85/95/105/115**. Bellcopper is **significantly heavier and demands more handling STR / has a worse intrinsic mobility load than Boughsteel at equivalent class/quality/coverage**, INCLUDING in its Light configuration. This supersedes any notion that Light Bellcopper must be physically lightweight merely because its protective class is Light. **Exact numeric weight/STR/SPD ladders remain to be author-approved**, including this author's yet-unprovided preference on how large 'significant' is. Low/medium/full class armor retains its own acoustic specialty from previous approvals.

**AUTHOR-SELECTED KINETIC RESONANCE MECHANISM supersedes earlier 'halve incoming Attack Power' assistant proposal:** When Heavy Bellcopper's kinetic reservoir is fully **EMPTY/Ready**, grant **+100% to final physical Defense Power** (= ×2.00). When Medium Bellcopper's reservoir is fully EMPTY/Ready, grant **+50% to final physical Defense Power** (= ×1.50). Calculate conventional physical Defense Power (effective END² + applicable effective AR², with armor penetration/gap rules) FIRST, then multiply **the final Defense Power linearly just once** as an after-calculation factor; DO NOT double base AR or END before squaring, alter MR, or multiply the attacker's Power. With ANY stored kinetic energy, either class returns to **normal unmodified physical Defense Power**. The bonus is for defending against an actual relevant physical armor-contacting attack when the reservoir is fully empty; its absorption response generates/stores kinetic energy to be released acoustically. This does not create a passive global Defense bonus for unarmored/uncovered sites, psychic attacks or spells producing direct energy without physical impact, nor a free second physical Defense calculation.

**APPROVED THREE-TURN DRAIN PRINCIPLE:** A charged reservoir needs **three turns to empty and reset**; meaningful additional impacts stop it emptying until the wearer's armor has a three-turn break from meaningful hits. Author describes all stored-energy cases as full loss of the special Defense multiplier, not a proportional bonus while partly charged. Acoustic output, when and where sound pulses are released, and interactions with stealth/hearing remain open. Preserve Light Bellcopper's near-total movement quieting and grapple-contact vocal hush; Medium's partial suppression; Heavy's one-hit reservoir specialty. No shield-style durability meter or separate raw-energy accounting is necessary.

**DESIGN QUESTIONS/PROPOSALS NOT YET APPROVED:** The precise trigger defining a 'meaningful hit' and whether an ultimately superficial hit made superficial by the doubled Defense still charges the reservoir. Quill recommends testing 'actual gear-contacting physical strike which would have been at least Solid versus NORMAL Defense Power' to avoid tiny harmless taps resetting the armor indefinitely, but this is NOT yet approved. Quill recommends resolving the charged/ready status upon the eligible intercepted blow and counting recovery at end of the wearer's turn without qualifying additional strikes. Numeric Heavy STR48/inherent SPD−25% versus Boughsteel candidate STR36/−20%, Medium/Light proportionate heavier profiles, are TEST OPTIONS ONLY, not author approvals. The mechanism of spectral/acoustic release, sound AoE/status, physical hit classification, effect of damaged armor and timing of reset remain open. **Examples (not independent approval of any new Power rule):** against END139, QV Full Heavy Bellcopper AR115 gives Defense 19321+13225=32546; empty multiplier x2 yields 65092; a QV 34970.87 attack is Solid normally and Superficial on first interception.


## November 8, 2026 — Oathsilver numbers and oath-assisted attunement APPROVED; Bellcopper three-class sonic identity APPROVED

### Oathsilver latest explicit numeric and narrative approvals

**AUTHOR APPROVES PREVIOUS OATHSILVER PROPOSAL:** Quality I–V Oathsilver provides a **+3% / +6% / +9% / +12% / +15%** bonus, applied **once** to each qualifying *existing installed enchantment's numerical effect*, never a blanket multiplier to total combat Power/Defense or an automatic extra spell rank, action, socket, or status. The approved working **Quality V Full Heavy Oathsilver** defensive baseline is **AR75 / MR60**, before installed enchantment effects. Eligibility and rounding for edge-case nonnumeric effects remain to be defined during enchantment design. Existing crafter-determined enchantment slot count, equipment Soul Strain, and item requirements do not change. Reattunement remains important following changed ownership.

**AUTHOR ADDS APPROVED OATH-BASED ATTUNEMENT DESIGN:** Keeping a sincere personal oath, following through on meaningful commitments and persistent honesty **can speed Oathsilver's attunement**, providing quest/character-building opportunities. Do not hard-code a universal moral alignment system, automatic truth detection, a fixed time discount or a requirement to undertake an arbitrary quest to wear the armor: exact attunement time, credible oath adjudication, sincerity, character-specific vows, transfer rules and shortcuts remain OPEN. This is an affirmative quest design hook and an attunement acceleration principle, not mandatory religious devotion.

### Bellcopper author-approved qualitative armor identity

**APPROVED DISTINCT LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY FUNCTIONS:** Bellcopper already has acoustic resonance properties. **Light Bellcopper** is optimal for stealth: almost silences the wearer's bodily/equipment movement and can **suppress a grappled target's audible cries/vocal output at actual grapple/contact distance** to facilitate stealth takedowns. This is a sound-muffling capability, not an automatic grapple success, free injury or universal prohibition on spellcasting/psychic thought; standard grapple/reach/action rules still matter. **Heavy Bellcopper** is a single-impact kinetic/acoustic defensive specialist, storing/catching kinetic force from a physical strike and **releasing it as sound**. Its main strength is facing **one meaningful physical blow**, not an unlimited barrier against many quick blows. A charged/saturated resonator takes **three turns free from meaningful refreshing physical hits** to fully empty/reset; additional meaningful physical blows **prevent its reservoir from emptying** and consequently keep its best single-blow response unavailable (or sharply reduced). **Medium Bellcopper** combines weaker Light sound muffling (reduces sound but does not eliminate it) and a smaller/weaker version of the Heavy kinetic reservoir. Preserve distinct roles; no extra action, automatic acoustic injury or universally granted MR against sound without further approval.

**MECHANICAL DESIGN STILL OPEN, NOT AUTHOR-APPROVED NUMERICS:** Define exactly how physical strikes enter and leave a reservoir, the first-hit Power/Defense interaction, sound release timing/range/area and statuses, loudness and audible counterplay, what counts as a 'meaningful hit' for reservoir upkeep, whether the wearer chooses audible output direction, the three-turn timing at beginning/end of turn, Light vocal silencing against covered/obstructed targets, MR/AR/STR/SPD and passive Soul Strain. **QUILL TEST PROPOSAL, NOT CANON:** Treat Heavy as starting Ready; on an actual covered physical strike that *would* result in a Solid-or-worse physical injury, once per fully reset reservoir, halve incoming physical Attack Power for the strike and release a distinct sound pulse. Mark the suit Ringing after this one interception. While Ringing, do not halve additional blows; at each of wearer's turn ends without any qualifying meaningful strike, progress a 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 settling count back to Ready, with a qualifying hit resetting settling to zero. Medium may reduce only 25% of incoming Power with the same three-turn settling, rather than becoming a perpetual reduced-hit formula. No free audible attack Power or stun, hearing injury, AoE suppression, automatic perception bypass or silence on allied characters is created by the concept alone. Physical AR and END still contribute under their existing rules; testing should prevent double mitigation and perma-free sound damage. Alternatively adjust the exact multipliers and trigger upon the author's feedback.

## November 8, 2026 — Armor vs Elemental Magnitude philosophy ratified; Nullporcelain design brief

**AUTHOR-RATIFIED DESIGN PHILOSOPHY:** Conventional armor's ordinary physical Armor Rating does **not** itself reduce Elemental Magnitude and does **not** protect against direct psychic/mind effects. Elemental and supernatural defenses depend on legitimate protective materials, enchantments, insulation, conductivity, barriers, obstruction and applicable specific Resistance. Actual physical projectiles/impacts generated by spells are resolved as physical threats (with relevant physical armor), not granted Nullporcelain anti-spell benefit merely because magic propelled them. Do not negate END, special Resistances, meaningful pathways, or established Sorcery mechanics. Exact Elemental Magnitude and material-specific reduction calculations remain open.

**NULLPORCELAIN AUTHOR DESIGN DIRECTION, PRE-NUMERIC (not final stat rules):** Nullporcelain is deliberately fragile against physical blows, offers low physical protection and may genuinely break; favor a minimal breakage procedure linked to qualifying actual physical injury rather than separate shield-style HP/durability counters. Armor degradation persists after its wearer is magically or mundanely healed and requires actual equipment repair. Ordinary energy-spell exposure does **not** itself crack Nullporcelain. It is a premium mage-hunting material that greatly reduces intensity/effect of incoming directly magical spells; anti-magic defense must not also block indirectly generated physical impacts such as rocks launched by magic. Conventional attack/armor coverage is preserved for targeted attacks. Ordinary broad magical area attacks should generally assess a worn Nullporcelain outfit's magical protection as hit/engaged directly, subject to actual delivery and genuinely unprotected-path exceptions; this does not make exposed skin physically armored or grant blanket protection from separate physical debris. A **distinct Nullporcelain HELMET** is desired as a rare, deliberate exception to all-of-one-outfit material uniformity: anti-psychic and mental-spell protection, including fear spells, without forcing per-boot, per-arm, or per-panel bookkeeping. The helmet's protection, interaction with area effects, cost/load, and physical targeting must be bounded when numerical mechanics are proposed. No breakage-trigger bands, AR, magnitude reductions, helmet benefits or new SP/MP fees have yet been approved.

**QUILL'S UNAPPROVED SIMPLIFICATION TO TEST:** On an actual physically armor-contacting injurious attack, use the physical injury severity to mark Nullporcelain Cracked or Shattered; superficial contact and direct psychic wounds do not crack it; a broken state persists despite wearer healing. Do not automatically crack torso armor because the wearer was wounded through an uncovered hand. This is a proposal and needs author approval alongside statistics.

## November 8, 2026 — Universal armor coverage burden and uniform composite protection (LATEST AUTHOR DIRECTION)

**AUTHOR DIRECTION:** Minimize complexity; Partial / Standard / Full coverage use ONE universal physical-burden schedule for all armor classes and materials, and a composite's stated main-surface AR is uniform across its actually covered main surfaces. Do not separately calculate breastplate, arm, boot, or material-panel AR within one specified composite profile. True uncovered targets remain AR0; Medium/Heavy protected structural joints retain their established built-in AR25; actual armor class and coverage must still determine what is covered. No separate glove/boot weight ledger.

**FIXED COVERAGE BURDEN VALUES:** Relative to the Full-coverage armor of the *same class, material composition and quality*, Partial armor takes **60%** of Full support STR and **60%** of Full inherent SPD-penalty magnitude; Standard **80%** of both; Full **100%** of both. Round resulting STR UP to a whole point, and round resulting inherent SPD penalty to the nearest whole percentage point, halves upward. Do not reduce AR on legitimately covered main surfaces; the same wearer's effective SPD is multiplied once by `(1 - final inherent penalty / 100)`, plus separately applicable established penalties. Quality's approved physical requirement discount applies BEFORE coverage scaling; do not apply quality twice. These are armor *coverage* rules, not a new material AR conversion equation, enchantment bonus, or shield rating rule.

**FINAL QV FULL HEAVY COMPOSITE REFERENCE PROFILES, as previously author-approved:** substantial Trufula/Boughsteel **AR105 / support STR28 / inherent SPD −16%**; substantial Trufula/Adamantite **AR135 / STR55 / SPD −21%**. Their derived coverages: Trufula/Boughsteel **Partial STR17, −10%; Standard STR23, −13%; Full STR28, −16%**. Trufula/Adamantite **Partial STR33, −13%; Standard STR44, −17%; Full STR55, −21%**. These two are reference engineered constructions, not an unlimited material mixing recipe; no extra independent layering or best-of-all-material bonuses. The earlier pure Full Heavy material-quality AR ladders and composite Fire ×2 / valid conductive Lightning ×3 weaknesses remain unchanged. Specific pure-material support/Speed candidates, other armor-class base requirements, universal mixing equations, costs, ignition thresholds and precise elemental source/Resistance ordering remain separate unfinished design tasks, not silently finalized here.

## November 7, 2026 — Hatchbane evidence and Deep Inquiry procedure approved (LATEST)

- **Approved:** Court of Fangs addresses motive, opportunity and means; authenticated **mirror evidence** and eyewitness accounts are favored, with independent corroboration and consideration of exculpatory evidence. Free-folk testimony traditionally receives greater weight than enslaved testimony, but corroborated enslaved testimony is admissible. Direct proof can establish guilt without separately proving a specific motive.
- **Approved thresholds:** Third Degree **preponderance of evidence**, Second Degree **clear and convincing**, First Degree **beyond reasonable doubt**. First Degree normally calls for two independent evidentiary foundations; independently authenticated exceptionally clear mirror evidence can suffice.
- **Approved five stages:** petition/protection, investigation, hearing, judgment, sentence/review. Include Third-Degree welfare follow-up, Banebrand identity verification and independent review before irreversible punishment.
- **Approved Writ of Deep Inquiry:** narrowly scoped, independent Crown Arbiter authorization of dangerous compelled deep mind reading or memory extraction only for exceptionally grave unresolved cases, with substantial independent evidence, exhaustion of safer methods, necessity/proportionality, scope limits, witnessed documentation and restrictions on unrelated discoveries. Informed consent governs voluntary limited examination. Free persons' independent rights to silence and mental privacy remain recognized; invoking them is not proof of guilt.
- Outstanding specifics include examiner qualifications, appeals timing, slave protections, and writ refusal/remedies. Supersedes earlier entries marking these procedures as proposals.

## November 7, 2026 — Mirror evidence and separate mental privacy/silence rights (LATEST)

- **Approved correction:** mirrors record visual/audio information; Orbs **store** mirror recordings but cannot directly record sight or sound. Call video/audio recordings **mirror evidence**, not 'Orb recordings'. Authenticated mirror evidence and eyewitness accounts are favored; Imperial courts tend to favor free-folk over enslaved eyewitness testimony.
- **Approved:** psionic mind reading, Orbcraft memory extraction and Tidekin Mirrorwake may support innocence or guilt, but are not infallible. Compelled deep mind reading or memory transfer is painful, dangerous, potentially permanently harmful, and restricted in principle to very high-stakes cases with extensive independent evidence when ordinary proof remains inconclusive. Trivial emotion-reading capability does not imply unrestricted admissibility.
- **Approved:** free people hold separate rights to **silence** and **mental privacy**. They can invoke each independently; unconsented emotional readings cannot be used as evidence or grounds for suspicion. Masters have significant authority over whether and how their slaves are questioned; exact bounds remain open.
- **PROPOSED ONLY:** a special **Writ of Deep Inquiry**, requiring independent Crown Arbiter authorization, necessity, proportionality, exhaustion of safer means and a limited scope. Prior suggested evidence thresholds and court workflow are also pending explicit approval.

## November 7, 2026 — Kharak compassion toward other races' children (LATEST)

It provides grounds for cross-cultural kinship, adopted/protected outsiders, and soldiers' crises of conscience.
- **Approved historical direction:** generations of Kharak families, elders and warriors began rejecting ancestral Extinction practices before Vornak; he helped give the emerging protective ethic the force of law rather than single-handedly inventing it. Exact legislative history remains open.
- **Still PROPOSED:** three-part motive/opportunity/means review, evidentiary preference for authenticated Orb records and free-folk eyewitnesses, tiered proof thresholds, and court sentencing workflow. No new procedural specifics canonized pending author approval.

## November 7, 2026 — Hatchbane degrees, ancient substitution and Kharak Extinction past (LATEST)

- **Approved Third Degree:** substantial neglect/disrespect, poor food/lodging and abusive care, including failures caused by compulsory slave duties; reparations, often humiliating apology, mandatory excellence in subsequent care; repeated failure may escalate.
- **Approved Second Degree:** substantial harm or kidnapping of eggs/hatchlings, including attack upon a Kharak carrying an unlaid egg; court establishes seriousness and culpability. Attacker and superior who culpably allowed it may share guilt, not automatic strict liability. **Banebrand** is a permanently painful, nonhealing magical mark, with possible clan reorganization. Repeat Hatchbane after Banebrand may bring loss of station or death; higher rank implies greater responsibility, not immunity.
- **Approved First Degree:** deliberate killing, attempted killing, exceptionally grave abuse, commissioned assassination of eggs/hatchlings, and foreseeable/accepted killing during commissioned kidnapping. Command responsibility is evaluated through proof of culpability. Loss of title and Coil; **Decimation** by a follower of Arrest for those without comparable status, subject to further accountability for powerful offenders. Exact procedure open.
- **Ancient exception:** almost never invoked in independent, non-Arrest Kharak clans, not ordinary Imperial law: a freely volunteering **independent adult offspring** may offer life as substitute. Only a **true Serpentari** has ancestral authority to rescind the old provision. Coercion invalidates the offer; enormous consequences and continuing dishonor. Its historical origin and formal operation remain unresolved.
- **Historical contrast:** early Khans before Vornak practiced **Extinction**, destroying enemy bloodlines and sometimes entire minor species, including children. Modern Hatchbane reflects Kharak movement toward protective justice, albeit imperfectly. Vornak's precise reforms remain open. See `33_Kharak_Rexfolk_Culture_and_Command.md`.

## November 7, 2026 — Kharak name, Rexfolk philosophy, military hierarchy and challenges approved (LATEST)

- **Name approved:** **Kharak**, with Rexfolk a descriptive everyday designation. The new reference is `33_Kharak_Rexfolk_Culture_and_Command.md`.
- **Race:** Very large tyrannosaur mortal warrior people; common but fewer than Duskpaws, main feared heavy combatants of the Naga Imperium; ordinary work-slave employment rare. Desired red affinity, greatest playable-race Strength, huge bite and oversized weapons; precise mechanics **not yet established**.

- **Approved worldview:** Belonging to a worthy hierarchy is honorable; unwanted freedom and clanlessness can be humiliating. Allegiance is tied to earned competence, not meek surrender; independent clans may act as mercenaries or bandits and violently resist unearned captivity. A defeated clan may elect to swear service.
- **Approved ranks:** Fang, Bloodfang, Clawleader, Warhowler, Warclaw, Warchief, High Warchief. **First Fang** is the senior Rexfolk servant immediately beneath a Matriarch, distinct from a universal military rank.

A later Rexfolk ideological tradition paradoxically praises the imposed order; Naga then fostered closer military and cultural partnerships. Exact mutual fashions/customs not yet approved.
- **Right of Challenge:** First Fang has standing and responsibility to challenge evidence-backed leadership failures, including failed stewardship of small household gangs, major campaigns and economic/reputational collapse. Documentary precedent and clear terms matter. Legitimate reassignment inside the Imperial hierarchy is distinct from desertion/rebellion; overzealous challengers may be punished or demoted. Competing Matriarch offers or redeployment of modest units are recognized possibilities. **Drakyn** favored as legal intermediaries/judges; court titles and detailed procedure are still proposals.
- **Founding Khan:** Author established the intended concept of a great near-unifier and intellectual/martial lawgiver, eventually defeated by a Serpentari in a nonviolent test of power associated with the origin of Imperial sports. Identity, nature of that contest and historical particulars remain **OPEN**, and must respect approved `17_Imperial_Sports_and_Great_Coil_Circuit.md`.

## November 6, 2026 — Kobold Presentation and Demonstration Dress approved (LATEST)

- **Explicit author approval:** All six sections of the Kobold **Presentation Dress versus Demonstration Dress** proposal, including the cherished **Working Coat**, the practical-versus-symbolic use of the **Proud Tool**, and their implications for free and enslaved professionals. The distinction is a widespread **cultural convention**, not mandated clothing or a statutory costume category.
- **Presentation Dress:** Clean and composed professor-style attire for lectures, court, examinations and formal audiences; may include academic coats, fitted waistcoats, short skirts/petticoats, spectacles, polished instruments and appropriate Orb interfaces. It is not restricted to rich Kobolds.
- **Demonstration Dress:** Functional worn, repaired or scorched workwear appropriate for live invention demonstrations, practical examinations, competitions and laboratory work. Genuine work wear may be respected, but artificially inflicted damage does not signify expertise; safety and useful tools still matter.
- **Working Coat:** Familiar patches, sleeves and custom pockets can give an engineer's older coat personal and technical value beyond its price; even a wealthy free inventor may favor one.
- **Proud Tool:** Important tools or personal inventions may be displayed ceremonially in Presentation Dress, or used as actual working implements in Demonstration Dress. Decorative patron gifts such as golden replicas are possible, **not required** or proof of skill.
- **Class and autonomy:** Owner-maintained uniforms and Naga expectations may clash with free Kobold informality. The difference is rooted in clothing choice and control, not innate competence or a foolproof legal-status indicator.

Orbcraft practitioners can directly understand/manipulate the information stream. The functional Orb Collar has one central colored Orb, smooth metal, no exposed restraint hardware; a paw-operated local aurora gives unskilled observers a mild headache, but communicates rich information to Orbcrafters. The **Shock Collar** is medium-mana, deliberate/manual control normally, optionally checking exit from a *specific* Rainbow region; it cannot universally infer thoughts, weapon handling, secrets or intent, nor activate remotely from any arbitrary location. Their practical appearances override ordinary race-specific collars. Fine costs/durations/checks/thresholds are not approved.
- **Censure Collar / Censureband** is only a proposed name for the Shock Collar; **NOT APPROVED**.

## 2. Canon approvals / revision history

### November 5, 2026 — Hero Gem wealth, consumables, shop buyback, and threat rewards (LATEST)

- **Explicit author approval:** `09_Equipment_and_Economy.md` now owns the typical Hero equipment-wealth curve `W(L) = 3 + 3997 × ((L−1)/99)^2.3` (levels 1–100), targeting **3 Gems in equipment at level 1** and **4,000 Gems of currently owned equipment at level 100**, with the latter reflecting a **typical Hero who replaces equipment at every quality tier**, not an unusually thrifty Hero.
- **Approved spending and resale:** By level 100, approximately **30% of all Gems ever earned** is spent on consumables. Gem Shops buy back **items they originally sold** for **half their original purchase price**. Replacement losses are incorporated into the typical earnings budget, not compensated by a free reimbursement.
- **Reference model:** Quality milestones at Hero levels **10, 25, 50, 75, 100** are balancing assumptions, **not equipment-use prerequisites**. The representative portfolio values are **19 / 157 / 796 / 2,049 / 4,000 Gems**; four complete replacement resales create **~1,510.5 Gems of cumulative losses**. With `E(L) = (W(L) + R(L)) / 0.70`, the level-100 lifetime target is **~7,872 Gems earned**, **~2,362 Gems spent on consumables**, and **4,000 Gems currently in equipment**. Half-Gem arithmetic does not establish a fractional Gem denomination.
- **Gem reward multipliers explicitly match existing XP multipliers:** **Horde ×0.1, Minion ×0.4, Henchman ×1, Elite ×2**. A **Boss** grants a special Gem reward equivalent to **two levels of budgeted Gem progression**, including milestone replacement allowance where applicable; the existing Boss **XP** reward of exactly two level advances remains unchanged. **Do not adopt** the unapproved Elite ×3 / Minion ×0.5 XP suggestions from the immediately preceding discussion.
- **Reward calibration:** Base Gem rewards derive from the incremental lifetime earnings budget `E(L+1) − E(L)` and expected qualifying encounter/quest pacing. The exact encounter/quest allocation and fractional reward rounding remain unresolved. The two-level Boss Gem formula `E(L+2) − E(L)` is specified for **L+2 ≤100**; beyond-level-100 Gem progression is unresolved.
- **No changes:** Patron-specific eligibility, mundane quest limits, XP math, tier gates, shop catalogue item prices, five quality benchmarks, SP, and equipment usage requirements. Reference: `09_Equipment_and_Economy.md`, indexed in `00_Mystaria_Canon_Index.md`.



### November 5, 2026 — Shimmer XP progression and enemy threat classes approved (LATEST)

- **Explicit user approval:** Hero XP required to advance from level **L** to **L + 1** is **`L × (L + 1)`**, as a per-level requirement, not cumulative lifetime XP. Example thresholds: level 1 **2 XP**, level 50 **2,550 XP**, level 100 **10,100 XP**. XP carries through level transitions.
- **Ordinary qualifying reward:** **`XP = 2 × encounter level × threat modifier`**. A defeated enemy uses its own level; a qualifying quest or nonviolent patron-approved achievement can use a GM-assigned equivalent challenge level. Round to nearest whole XP, minimum **1 XP for a qualifying encounter**. Patron-specific XP rules and the fact that mundane quests do not automatically award XP remain operative.
- **Threat modifiers and relative-level guidelines:** **Horde ×0.1** (enemy level ≤50% of Hero); **Minion ×0.4** (>50%–80%); **Henchman ×1** (>80%–110%); **Elite ×2** (>110%–140%); **Boss** (usually >140% or specially designated). These are **guidelines**; the GM assigns actual encounter class based on capabilities and context, not level ratio alone. The categories indicate swarmable trivial enemies, minor threats, near-peers, minibosses and prepared prolonged bosses respectively.
- **Boss exception:** A qualifying Boss grants the remaining XP to the next level **plus** the full XP for the following level, advancing the Hero **exactly two levels from the Hero's current level and progress**. At level 50 with no progress, the reward is **5,202 XP** and the Hero reaches level 52. Boss XP replaces, rather than multiplies, ordinary enemy XP.
- **Pacing:** One equal-level Henchman at level 1 yields the **2 XP** needed to level; at level 100, an equal-level Henchman gives **200 XP** against **10,100 XP**, so **51** encounters are needed from zero progress (approximately the requested 50).
- **Not approved by implication:** The previously floated anti-farming numerical restriction and any party XP division procedure remain unspecified; merely trivial/repetitive acts are not automatically patron-qualified. This approval does **not** change Shimmer attribute gains, Skill Point costs, rank prerequisites, or the goddesses' established reward criteria.
- **Owning file:** `01_World_and_Shimmer.md`; indexed in `00_Mystaria_Canon_Index.md`.

### November 4, 2026 — Mindprism / Mnemonic Arts / Living Reliquaries approved (LATEST)

- **Approved technology and vocabulary:** Retinal **Mindprism** uses specially calibrated **Cipherlight** for the **Mnemonic Arts**. Approved terms: **Echo, Echo Orb, Everseal, Mindwright, Deepprint, Echoing, Mindcut, Echo Vault, Memory Bond, Dreamcasting, Dreamcaster, Dreamhouse, Skillprint, Living Reliquary, Hollow Reliquary**. Ordinary direct Cipherlight beams remain dangerously confusing.
- **Recording/medical ruling:** Copying a memory consumes **extravagant amounts of actual mana**, is expensive and often impractical; a basic recording has a **firearm-purchase-level relative price**, not a fixed Gem amount. Individual calibration and extreme neurological strain apply. Broad Deepprints can take days or years. Magic cannot heal this particular neurological injury: time is required, and severe Mindcuts can leave permanent damage. **Mindcut erases the original source memories** but can be much faster; it may be used to induce amnesia.
- **Law of Returning Echoes:** Recorded memories cannot be destroyed by mortal technology. All copies remain tied to the original source. Unsealed Echoes return to the **living** original owner; a continuously maintained **Everseal** using some actual mana prevents return. If every surviving implanted copy is lost with its recipients, the memory returns to the still-living owner. **Death of the original owner ENDS automatic return.** Returned memory does not cure brain damage; divine interventions retain their own laws.
- **Skillprints and Shimmer:** An advanced **Skillprint** can bestow an **actual Shimmer skill counted as purchased at no SP cost**. Normal level gates, chains and racial/physical/magical prerequisites remain controlling; no innate mana or Shimmer for non-Heroes. **~5 SP worth of skills per month** is a modest safety benchmark, with neurological harm risk beyond it. Such Skillprints are rare, usually medium- or high-level Hero treasures. No normal SP purchase costs, rank names or unrelated Crafts are modified.
- **Culture:** **Dreamcasting** streams actual subjective experience **in real time**, as distinct from uploading a previously recorded Echo. **Dreamhouses** and professional Dreamcasters are a major entertainment industry. **Echo Vaults** use maintained Echo Orbs, **Memory Bonds** pledge memory collateral. **Living Reliquaries** are enslaved intelligent living archives of foreign memories, while **Hollow Reliquaries** have their own histories forcibly Mindcut away; neither has unlimited capacity or loses personhood.
- **Canon boundaries:** This is a new technology, not a new Shimmer purchase table, Craft skill tree, Warlock soul vessel, or divine memory rule. The detailed controlling document is `19_The_Mnemonic_Arts_and_Echo_Economy.md`. Supporting references: `18_The_Gilded_Coil_Imperial_Gazetteer.md`, `01_World_and_Shimmer.md`, `12_Languages_and_Linguistic_Customs.md`, `13_Wakecraft_The_Six_Arts_of_the_Living_Tide.md`, `00_Mystaria_Canon_Index.md`.

### November 4, 2026 — Cipherlight, Coilnet Rainbows, language, and Mirrorwake (LATEST)

- **Approved name:** **Cipherlight** is the encoded, information-bearing optical medium of Kobold Orbcraft and Mirrorcraft; computational Orbs and Magic Mirrors encode/interpret it. **Lighthouses** act as beam relays. Reflective surfaces permit transmissions through water, including submerged and underground pipelines, potentially offering greater route security than exposed relays.
- **Approved coverage phenomenon:** An active Coilnet's coverage region is its **Rainbow**, visibly indicated by a subtle aurora-like upper-atmospheric shimmer; heavy traffic makes it stronger and more obvious. Even small independent networks (e.g. near a Drakyn lair) can attract interest. A new Rainbow can tip off guards to possible covert transmissions/foreign influence but does not prove a crime, pinpoint senders, or decode traffic.
- **Approved direct beam hazard:** Staring directly into Cipherlight produces **extreme confusion**. Numerical exposure and resistance mechanics were not specified.
- **Approved language:** The user approved the Kobold and regional sayings “You're speaking Cipherlight,” “Don't stare into the beam,” “Bright Rainbow!”, “Lost in the Rainbow,” “There's light beneath the water,” “All beam, no message,” “Under the same Rainbow,” “The Rainbow is burning,” “Beyond the Rainbow,” and “a beautiful headache.” These supplement rather than supersede older idioms. See `12_Languages_and_Linguistic_Customs.md`.
- **Approved regional reception:** Reactions vary among Imperial residents, Canopy populations, Vren, Duskpaws, Tidekin and remote Drakyn lairs. The regional security consequences appear in `18_The_Gilded_Coil_Imperial_Gazetteer.md`.
- **Approved Tidekin interaction:** **Mirrorwake detects Cipherlight through water exceptionally well** and retains strong, significant impressions of it. High-intensity traffic can overwhelm and obscure other water memories. Deliberate Cipherlight use can conceal evidence, and **particularly sophisticated interference can create false Mirrorwake evidence**. Detection does not automatically decrypt Coilnet communications; forging evidence is not automatically successful. This expands an environmental interaction only; **Mirrorwake ranks, SP costs and existing techniques are unchanged**. Owning reference `13_Wakecraft_The_Six_Arts_of_the_Living_Tide.md`.
- **Unresolved:** Precise optical coding, speed, range, atmospheric signal strength, direct-beam confusion duration, Mirrorwake forgery requirements and detection/contest tests. Do not invent quantitative standards.
- **Updated files:** `18_The_Gilded_Coil_Imperial_Gazetteer.md`, `12_Languages_and_Linguistic_Customs.md`, `13_Wakecraft_The_Six_Arts_of_the_Living_Tide.md`, `00_Mystaria_Canon_Index.md`, and this changelog.

## November 5, 2026 — Approved combat/endurance rules and clarification

**CANON:** Combat-only +10 offset before quadratic impact comparison, applied to attack and defense, without changing actual effective attributes or unrelated costs; exact impact thresholds 0–0.75 superficial, >0.75–1.75 solid (+1 injury), >1.75–3 devastating (+2), >3 overwhelming (+3). **Dagger = 1.0× STR, gauntlets = 1.0×, unarmed = 0.85×**; previous 0.85× dagger proposal superseded. Injury-stage stat penalties −5%, −10%, −15% total. Heroes and Legends have two extra Shimmer Guard injury buffers; Heroes' purple eye glow appears beyond the first wounded state, can be concealed at the price of full pain but with no further fixed numerical penalty; Legends receive only the extra guard states and may collapse immediately if their Guard is destroyed by loss of reputation and accumulated injuries exceed normal mortal capacity. A fully healthy protected Hero/Legend cannot ordinarily be removed with one overwhelming attack without DM exception. Superficial wounds recover on long rest; meaningful injuries require realistic healing durations, possibly permanent if not magically healed; magical treatment is standard. Recipient heal burn stacks with Soul Strain (5% superficial, 20% ordinary injury, 10% first extra Guard injury and 15% second extra Guard injury); up to two short rests partially reduce burn and a long rest removes it entirely. Guns' inherent damage is independent of Strength; damage/required-STR handling relationship, bracing, weight vs recoil, and extreme recoil injury (+1 wound state) approved in principle. **Adamantite** spelling confirmed (not Adamantine); **Crownsalt** may also be termed **gunpowder**. Trufula frame combustion restrictions remain in place.

**UNRESOLVED/PROPOSAL:** Numerical armor scaling/penetration and Centaur Smithcraft integration; exact firearm handling cutoffs, recoil wound trigger and sample gun ratings; short-rest heal-burn fraction and precise strain translation; coordinated attack numeric formula, separate physical/psychic tracks, precise Legend reputation threshold. The adopted armor combination formula remains a working formula pending full scaling balance. ## November 5, 2026 — Power and Resistance vocabulary (CANON)

**Approved nomenclature:** **Power** is a broadly usable scaling result for attacks, spells and other effects, not necessarily damage. **Resistance** is **effective END** (without adding the combat-only +10); type-specific resistances can organize narrowly applicable bonuses or penalties. **Defense** covers withstanding/mitigating an effect through Resistance and applicable protection, and **never includes evasion**. Evasion is resolved separately. Continue to derive natural **Defense Power = (Resistance + 10)²** and attack **Power** quadratically, retaining impact thresholds, penalties and weapon ratios. No numeric spell scaling or armor stacking is approved by renaming the terms. Cross-reference `22_Combat_Endurance_and_Shimmer_Guard.md`; detailed modifier precedence for casting implements, armor, oil vulnerabilities and barriers remains **UNRESOLVED**.


## November 5, 2026 — Speed / evasion philosophy and pressure ladder (CANON scope)

**Approved:** Primary skill output focus on STR/DEX/INT (future general SP skills are anticipated but **not designed or priced**); SPD helps both avoiding and landing attacks, favoring evasion and never directly providing extra attacks per action. Evasion negates attacks, and rarer glancing blows mitigate **roughly half of resulting injury states**, not offensive Power; rounding not fixed. END/Resistance is reliable against repeated weaker attacks while SPD is relatively strong against single dangerous attacks. Armor directly penalizes SPD (exact rates pending). The baseline Evasion Ratio uses `(defender effective SPD + 10)/(attacker effective SPD + 10)` with the **preserved six-category table** in `22_Combat_Endurance_and_Shimmer_Guard.md`: Certain <0.50; Easy 0.50–0.79; Average 0.80–1.24; Hard 1.25–1.49; Very Hard 1.50–2.99; Impossible ≥3.00. Circumstances and clear routes control whether an extreme disparity can be overcome. **Four pressure states**: Open, Pressured, Trapped, **Extreme Pressure** (e.g. entire army converging), without making a target categorically helpless. Area attacks, coordinated opponents, encirclement and terrain counter evasion. **Shimmer Guard predicted evasion paths** are now an in-world feature and rare DM tool for extreme Speed mismatches, **not** guaranteed hit, extra attack, or +SPD; exact thresholds/effects still unresolved. The earlier percentage-based Proposal Three is **disfavored**, retained only if needed as hidden rare technical balancing, never a play-facing mechanic.

**Unresolved:** Exact pressure-category shifts, glancing rounding, armor SPD penalties, final deterministic hit method, Shimmer prediction trigger/benefit, and SP skills. **Separate proposal, NOT APPROVED:** shifting all racial starting attributes +10; that would affect racial modifier order, MP, Channel Limits and INT-based ranges. Existing actual attribute baselines and combat-only +10 remain operative until explicit approval.

## November 5, 2026 — Approved +10 starting-attribute migration (LATEST)

**CANON:** Increase every approved **Hero racial starting base attribute +10**, **before** racial percentage modifiers, intentionally increasing differences from racials; clamp all attributes, including special monsters, to absolute **minimum 1**. Monsters may still possess any stat in **1–9** (do not mass-upgrade monster stats). Rebase effective-stat milestones **25 → 35**, **100 → 110**. Replace the combat-only +10 formulas with direct squares of **new effective** STR/END and direct new SPD ratio (old +10 is superseded; no double count). Maintain original injury and six-tier evasion tables. Adopt the quadratic illustrative lifting benchmark `100 × (effective STR / 15)^2` lb for one-time waist-height lifting, with STR 10 ≈44 lb, STR 15 =100 lb and STR 25 ≈278 lb; anatomical limitations still apply.

**MAGIC:** Natural MP intentionally increases to floor(rebased effective END) for mana-producing races; **Moontouched and Drakyn retain 0 natural MP**. Attribute-derived **short-range magic and Channel Limits** use clamped legacy-equivalent INT `max(1, new effective INT − 10)` (e.g. Hydrokinesis `2 + max(1, INT − 10)` m; Manabending `2 + 2×max(1, INT − 10)` m). At new effective INT 11, these ranges are **3m/4m** respectively, not above 10m; previously longer-range magic's nature is preserved. Warlock temporary hand capacity uses `max(1, floor(max(1, new natural effective END − 10)/5))` to avoid an automatic handling buff. Channel Limits do NOT increase by two due only to stat rebase. Minor racial-percent differences in these conversions are intentional. All existing mana-derived ability costs must be **reviewed later**; no SP/MP costs automatically changed now. Further fixed attribute prerequisites and historic benchmark examples need audit. ## November 5, 2026 — DEX stealth/contingencies, non-Hero training, movement tiers (LATEST)

**CANON:** DEX combines precise timing and physical perception, improves conventional stealth **and counter-stealth** through quiet movement, cover and reading physical cues, and does **not** create visibility-proof stealth in the open. It does **not** automatically grant specialized trained crafts such as lockpicking. Prediction rule preserved at **DEX ≥ 75% of target SPD**; new exception **DEX ≥ 200% of target SPD** gives no penalty from an incorrect prediction (well-built contingencies), though unrelated tactical risks still apply. **Non-Hero mortals can increase attributes through training**; **Heroes cannot**, because Shimmer level/experience growth governs their stat gains. Ordinary marathon capability benchmark is **END 25**, not 15, subject to circumstances.

**High-speed attacks:** An actual sufficiently accelerated movement-assisted charge can obtain a **modest Power benefit**, based on **relative closing speed**. No extra attacks. If an opponent's matching movement cancels relative closing-speed difference, the movement-derived Power bonus is nullified. Maximum movement is **dash**; sprint is one chart tier below; sustainable jog two below. Numeric movement mph, required run-up, travel durations, and approximate **+25% Power at 100 mph and +50% at 500 mph** are still **UNRESOLVED/PROPOSED CALIBRATION**, not universally applied multipliers. Preserve existing firearm benchmarks, evasion difficulty and pressure categories.

**Proposed only: PROFICIENCIES**: Possible later general/mundane, SP-purchased, attribute-gated expertise, including lockpicking and ordinary crafts. **NONCANON and requires further development**; raise only if the author proposes adopting a general skill system from another RPG, **not when discussing Mystaria magic Skills/Crafts**. No SP costs, proficiencies, prerequisites or unlocks established. Passive fire/ice/water/lightning/air/toxic runes apply a weaker, resisted **contact rider** on a weapon strike that genuinely contacts a protected surface or target, potentially affecting a wearer despite an otherwise superficial physical attack. A full dodge yields no contact effect. Not an independent full elemental Power attack (rejected A) and not default fractional physical-Power conversion (rejected C). ## November 6, 2026 — Three-turn Windling targeted sonic pursuit (LATEST)

**CANON APPROVED:** A Windling swarm's primary offensive action is **targeted sonic distraction** using its Cogsong-compatible music boxes. **One commander attack action** instructs the assigned swarm to follow and harass **one specified target for up to three turns**, after which the offensive instruction expires. This is **one sustained attack command**, not three separate attack actions; new targets and fresh sonic assaults still require new command actions. The pursuit's three-turn duration is not prolonged by temporary obstruction or escape. Windlings must be very close to impose their sonic threat: separation of **approximately five meters from an ordinary swarm generally ends new exposure**. The target may escape, use effective sound barriers, physically cover/protect ears or strike the close-range Windlings; melee fighters have practical counterattacks. Stat-relative pressure, bounded size multipliers and the ability of high-SPD or well-defended creatures to ignore ineffectual threats remain canon. Existing injuries may persist after exposure ends.

**Cogsong and receiver boundaries:** Windling weapon frequencies are engineered not to jam their own Cogsong command channels. Sonic assault is an active offensive order, not free recurring damage during screen/carry tasks. Effective sustained exposure may eventually damage another construct's receiver, preventing new commands without automatically destroying chassis or Leywell. Exact acoustic effects, sonic magnitude, countermeasure bonuses, receiver failure thresholds, and interleaving multi-turn orders remain **UNAPPROVED**. This limited sustained-attack exception refines, rather than cancels, the standard rule that every new attack needs a command.

## November 6, 2026 — Reach classes, inside fighting, shield roles and Light baseline (LATEST)

**APPROVED:** Distinguish physical **Light/Medium/Heavy weapon handling class** from **Short/Medium/Long Reach** and attack Coverage. Short weapons work at grapple distance/where movement is possible. Medium weapons offer a general compromise. Long weapons, while effectively controlling distance, can **prevent ordinary Short weapon attacks until opponents close**, while making attacks by Medium users **harder** rather than strictly impossible. The long-wielder **loses reach-control advantage when meaningfully Pressured**, not simply when any harmless foe takes an action. Once a Short wielder successfully closes and **grapples inside** a Long weapon's usable reach, normal long-reach strikes against that opponent become **impossible** unless a qualifying grip technique or restored distance permits them; escape/other legal actions still possible. Exact reach distances, movement costs, evasion shifts, DEX/SPD implementation and exceptions are UNRESOLVED.

**PROFICIENCY DOCKET:** Add **Choking Up** as a suggested specialized technique that lets a fighter shorten grip on a long weapon to operate closer. **General mundane Proficiencies and this skill remain PROPOSED, not canon**; no cost/level gate approved.

**SHIELDS APPROVED DESIGN:** A handheld shield occupies one hand and may offer (1) **passive location-specific protection**, (2) **active directional blocking/parrying**, (3) **contextual evasive deflection**. Numerical adjustments, shield bash, equipment attachment, coverage and stacking deferred until armor. This complements, not replaces, dual-wield offhand Attack/Defense assignment. Do not give free full-body shield armor.

**WEAPON REFERENCE CHANGE:** The author called fixed **Dagger = 1.00×** merely a placeholder and accepts **Light weapon = 1.00× baseline attack-rating reference** instead. Medium 1.15× and Heavy 1.30×, proposed form and armor-bypass coefficients, exact Reach/Coverage and attribute scaling remain proposals. **Armor Rating bypass is specifically postponed until armor design** rather than finalizing 40/0/20% now.
